Tumour-mode copy-number caller

Source: R/clones_tumour.R
caller_tumour.Rd

Full loop: split_votes() (discovery / test halves) -> clone feature matrix (discovery half, re-oriented by the all-cell pseudobulk) -> discover_clones() -> merge_clones() (test half) -> global EM round -> within-trunk discovery (discover_within()) -> clone_profiles() -> fit_clone_states() -> segment_clone() -> doublet clones -> assign_cells() (em_rounds hard-EM rounds: the clone states are re-profiled on the members of the previous round, the singlets with posterior >= member_post; clones left with fewer than min_size members leave the member set; the assignment's clone is every cell's likelihood-best clone, confident = posterior >= min_post and not doublet-like) -> clean_reference() -> optional depth re-pass relative to the clean pool -> per-cell calls. Each cell inherits its clone's non-neutral segments (source = "inherited") and is confirmed when its own score under the clone state (depth + allele LLR vs neutral; allele term two-sided, or one-sided on the clone-oriented votes with opts$confirm_sided = "one") is above the threshold of the tumour null: reference-pool cells x all pieces + all cells x control pieces, scored as the best of the loss / gain / CN-LOH / amp states (type-7 null_q quantile per stratum, strict >; pooled over strata below min_null_rows).

Usage

caller_tumour(
  feat,
  params = caller_defaults(),
  multiplets = NULL,
  control_regions = NULL,
  opts = clone_defaults(),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

feat

scn_features list

params

caller_defaults()

multiplets

optional data.table cell, prob (multiplet_table()); cells above opts$multiplet_prob are excluded from discovery and pseudobulks but assigned and flagged

control_regions

optional user control regions (regions table) replacing the automatic ones (of the confirmation null and of the reference cleaning, clean_reference())

opts

tumour-mode options (clone_defaults())

verbose

log progress

Value

scphasedcn (mode tumour) with clones, assignments, segments, profiles, calls (plus extra: intermediate results in null_fit$clones)

Details

Input feat (the feature step's scn_features, or an equivalent list): features (long table), regions, votes, atoms, cells (data.table with cell, in vote index order; n_frag / stratum), win (1 Mb window depth: list(windows, x, e) with windows x cells matrices, or a long table cell, chrom, start, end, x, e) and null_fit (list with tpar = fit_depth_null() table and rho).
